view: PA (frontal); "L" side marker at image upper-right confirms conventional orientation (patient left = image right)
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration (~9-10 posterior ribs), adequate penetration (spine visible through heart), minimal rotation, scapulae partly overlapping upper lateral lung fields; no cropping of costophrenic angles

devices.location: image upper-right corner, over patient's left shoulder soft tissue

abnormalities.finding: faint linear/band-like opacities at the lung base with subtle retrocardiac density and slight crowding of vessels, consistent with subsegmental/basal atelectasis (the labelled finding)
mild elevation of the left hemidiaphragm (nearly level with the right), suggesting left basal volume loss; gastric air bubble beneath
tortuous, unfolded thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob (age-related ectasia); mediastinal contour otherwise midline
prominent density at the left hilum / aortopulmonary region, most likely vascular (tortuous aorta / pulmonary artery) but a hilar mass cannot be fully excluded
left costophrenic angle slightly less sharp than the right - equivocal minimal pleural thickening or trace effusion
degenerative changes of both glenohumeral joints / shoulders

description_zh: 胸部正面（PA）X光，吸氣量尚可，穿透度適當，縱膈大致居中。左下肺野可見淡薄之線狀／帶狀密度增加，並伴有心後區密度稍增及左側橫膈輕度抬高，疑為左下肺次節段性肺擴張不全（atelectasis），範圍約4–6公分。胸主動脈迂曲、主動脈弓突出，符合年長者主動脈延展；左肺門／主動脈肺窗處密度較高，多為血管性結構，惟無法完全排除腫塊。右肺野清晰，右側肋膈角銳利、左側稍模糊；未見氣胸、胸管、中心靜脈導管或心律調節器等置入物，僅見影像右上角（病人左側）之「L」側別標記。
